scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c green,blue --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run backend:run"
scripts.db:generate: cd backend/src/Hospitality.Persistence && dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate
scripts.db:update: cd backend/src/Hospitality.Persistence && dotnet ef database update
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && dotnet restore
